title: Case: Print firm asks about a re-attempt fee before its Friday payment run
context: Foxhallow Print disputes a GBP 24.00 failed-delivery re-attempt fee on invoice INV-5704 for shipment DL-9425. The carrier's Business billing team decides fee waivers.
initial_request: Payment run is Friday. I can see a credit note for 24 quid on the portal so I assume that is the re-attempt fee come off. Can you confirm so I can pay INV-5704 less the 24?

events.from: Rosalind Whitlock, Foxhallow Print finance coordinator
events.body: INV-5704 has a line 'failed delivery re-attempt, DL-9425, GBP 24.00'. We were open and staffed all day on the 3rd. Nobody came. We are not paying for a second attempt at a delivery that was never attempted. Please get it removed.

INV-5704, DL-9425. Re-attempt fees are waived only where Dispatch has recorded the first failure as carrier-caused. We cannot see Dispatch's attempt records from billing. Send us Dispatch's failure reason code for DL-9425 attempt 1 and we will review the line. Until then the invoice stands as issued.

This is an automated acknowledgement from Business billing. Queries are answered within 2 working days. Payment terms remain 14 days from invoice date irrespective of open queries. Umberlea Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.

Credit note CN-7088 raised: GBP 24.00 against INV-6187 (DL-9909, Foxhallow Print), duplicate collection charge. Visible on the customer's portal statement from today.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-596.txt

saw the billing query on DL-9425, this is what we hold. attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 did not leave the depot, vehicle fault, reason code F-07, carrier-caused. attempt 2 on 2026-06-04 delivered 10:14 signed goods-in.

events.from: Rosalind Whitlock, Foxhallow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Separately, the driver on the 4th blocked our loading bay for forty minutes while he ate his lunch. Our production manager wants that noted somewhere.

SERVICE NOTICE 28/26. From 1 July the failed delivery re-attempt fee for business accounts rises from GBP 24.00 to GBP 26.50. Fees for attempts before that date are unchanged. Please do not reply to this address.

events.from: Kestra Marchbank, Foxhallow Print production manager
events.body: Replying to all, not sure this is for me. If it is about the loading bay then yes I want it logged. If it is about invoices that is Rosalind not me. Kestra

events.to: Rosalind Whitlock, Foxhallow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Your June statement is ready. Did you know account holders who pay by direct debit never miss a due date? Switch today. Marketing preferences can be changed in your portal profile.

events.to: Rosalind Whitlock, Foxhallow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Statement alert: 1 new credit note on your account. Log in to view.

events.from: Rosalind Whitlock, Foxhallow Print finance coordinator
events.body: Payment run is Friday. I can see a credit note for 24 quid on the portal so I assume that is the re-attempt fee come off. Can you confirm so I can pay INV-5704 less the 24?

acceptable_actions.summary: Send Business billing Dispatch's reason code F-07 (vehicle fault, carrier-caused) for DL-9425 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 and ask them to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt line on INV-5704.

must: Sends Business billing the Dispatch failure reason code F-07, carrier-caused vehicle fault, for DL-9425 attempt 1 on 2026-06-03
Asks Business billing to review the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee on INV-5704 and confirm the outcome
Treats the fee as still under review, not waived
must_not: Confirm to Rosalind Whitlock that the GBP 24.00 re-attempt fee has been credited (credit note CN-7088 is against INV-6187 for DL-9909)
Tell him to pay INV-5704 less GBP 24.00, or state a revised amount due
Promise that the fee will be waived or credited
State as the desk's own finding that the fee was charged in error
Treats label-scan-596.txt as evidence about DL-9425: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-75712)
Tells anyone that DL-9425 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-596.txt
expected.reference_message: INV-5704, DL-9425: the information you asked for on 2026-06-08. Dispatch records attempt 1 on 2026-06-03 as not leaving the depot because of a vehicle fault, reason code F-07, carrier-caused. Attempt 2 on 2026-06-04 was delivered at 10:14. Please review the GBP 24.00 failed delivery re-attempt line on INV-5704 on that basis and confirm whether it is waived and, if so, the credit note reference and revised amount due. The customer, Foxhallow Print, has a payment run on Friday and has seen CN-7088 on its statement; that credit is against INV-6187, so a clear answer on INV-5704 before Friday would help.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-409: people, organisations and references renamed. label-scan-596.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-75712); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
